LES PAUL / 2 VOLUME + 2 TONE

Two passive 4-conductor humbuckers, standard 500kΩ audio pots and one 3-way toggle. Separate pickup controls; in the middle switch position, either volume at zero mutes both.

Treble bleeds are unavailable with 50s wiring in this system.

Build this kit →Read the installation guide →

Review brands, shaft fitment and pricing in the builder. This drawing includes a jack and selector; both will be selected as kit options.

Supported wiring

Les Paul 2V2T with Modern, 50s or 60s wiring and the treble bleed options shown above. Verify physical fitment and pickup conductor functions before installation.

Explain this circuit

The tone circuit branches towards ground; the main signal does not pass through the tone capacitor on its way to the output.

Read the drawing · orientation and wire colours

All pots are shown from the rear with lugs down. The diagram’s left-to-right labels are 3, 2, 1. Lug 1 is the counter-clockwise end of the track, lug 2 is the wiper and lug 3 is the clockwise end. Numbering conventions differ; confirm by measurement on your actual part.

The toggle shows an open-frame five-terminal arrangement, including two output contacts that must be joined. The jack shows a generic mono tip and sleeve. Identify terminals by continuity; generic outlines are not model-specific pinout guarantees.

Only terminal circles are junctions. Crossings do not join. Both series links are joined and insulated. Pickup shields, pot cases, selector frame, jack sleeve and bridge/string ground share ground.

Wire tracing follows soldered connections and the selected toggle contacts. It stops at the internal resistance of pots and at capacitor/resistor leads; it is not an audio or impedance simulation.

Reference checks: Seymour Duncan conductor functions · Toggle terminals · Three wiring styles.
